list.title: Biological units
list.description: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} matching the current filters
list.searchPlaceholder: Code, name, cultivar, experiment or location
list.caption: Biological units
list.emptyBody: Units appear here once an experiment registers or receives material.
list.noMatchBody: Try a different search, or clear the filters to see everything.

banners.destroyedReadOnly: The record is final: events, results and documents can no longer be added. Only administrators can add notes.
banners.shippedUnknown: Shipped to an organization that was not recorded, effective
banners.shippedReadOnly: Nothing is left in stock, so the unit is inactive and its record is read-only. Its history is kept: every shipment, with the quantities that left.
banners.holdEffect: While the hold lasts, the unit cannot be moved, cannot change stage, cannot be derived from and cannot be destroyed. Lab results, incidents, notes and documents can still be recorded.
banners.holdAdminOnly: Only an administrator can release a hold.
banners.readOnly: You can view this unit but not change it. Administrators and members of its experiment can record events.

move.title: Move unit
move.description: Record that {name} is now in another location. The move is added to its history.
move.barcodeHint: Scan the label or type {name} to confirm you are moving the right unit.

stage.title: Change growth stage
stage.description: Record the stage {name} is now in. The change is added to its history.
stage.effectiveDateHint: Leave empty for now. A past date is allowed for a late entry and is marked as back-dated in the history.
stage.earlierHint: Stages only move forward: earlier stages are not offered.

measure.title: Record seed count
measure.description: Record a new seed count for {name}. Earlier counts stay in the history.
measure.descriptionWeight: Record a new wet or dry weight for {name}. Earlier weights stay in the history.
measure.locked: Recorded: {value}. Report a mistake as an incident.

derive.title: Derive new units
derive.description: Create clones, cuttings or subcultures from {name}. The parent is not changed.
derive.locationHint: Where the new units are placed.
derive.name: Name (optional)
derive.nameHint: Leave empty to name them automatically from {name}.
derive.next: Each new unit is registered with its own record, linked to this unit as its parent. The parent stays active.
derive.newExperimentHint: Created as a sub-experiment of {code}, led by you. The new units belong to it.
derive.successNewExperiment: {count, plural, one {Created {names}} other {Created # units: {names}}} in new experiment {experiment}

edit.title: Add notes
edit.notesDescription: This unit was destroyed. Administrators can still add or update notes.
edit.description: Changes to {name} are recorded in the audit trail with who made them.

linkParent.title: Link a parent unit
linkParent.description: Record which unit {name} was derived from.
linkParent.searchHint: Type at least two letters of its name, then pick it from the list.
linkParent.matches: {count, plural, one {# unit found} other {# units found}}
linkParent.permanent: A parent link cannot be changed or removed once it is recorded.

hold.title: Place on quality hold
hold.description: Stop changes to {name} while a quality question is looked into.
hold.reasonHint: Say what was observed. At least 3 characters.
hold.next: While on hold, the unit cannot be moved, cannot change stage, cannot be derived from and cannot be destroyed. Only an administrator can release it.

releaseHold.title: Release the hold on {name}?
releaseHold.description: The unit can be moved, changed, derived from and destroyed again. You may be asked for your password.
releaseHold.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. This is recorded with your name.

destroy.title: Record the destruction of {name}
destroy.description: Destruction removes the unit from inventory and is recorded permanently.
destroy.irreversible: This cannot be undone. The unit becomes read-only and the record names you.

test.title: Record a lab result
test.description: Add a result for {name}. A recorded result cannot be edited.
test.valueHint: Optional. Enter a result, a weight, or describe it in the comment.
test.noteHint: Describe the result here when there is no number, for example “not detected”.
test.sampleHint: The tissue sample the result is for, if any.

incident.title: Report an incident
incident.name: Title
incident.severityHint: A critical incident places the unit on hold automatically.
incident.successHeld: Incident opened. The unit was placed on hold.
incident.weightMistakeDescription: A recorded weight of {name} is wrong. Say which weight and what it should be: an administrator corrects it.

upload.title: Upload a document
upload.description: Attach a file to {name}. It is stored privately and its checksum is recorded.
upload.label: Label
upload.labelHint: A short name shown in the list.
upload.fileHint: PDF, Word, Excel, PNG, JPEG, WebP, CSV or plain text, up to 10 MB.

editDetails.title: Edit sex and stage
editDetails.description: Changes to {name} are recorded in its history and in the audit trail.
editDetails.stageHeld: The stage cannot be changed while the unit is on hold.
editDetails.stageNotApplicable: Stages apply to plants and flowers only.
editDetails.effectiveDateHint: Leave empty for now. A past date is allowed for a late entry.

sample.title: Take a sample
sample.description: Part of {name} becomes a sample: a unit of its own, with its own label and lab results. {name} keeps what is left.

kindHints.RELEASE: For the release testing of the lot.
kindHints.INTERNAL_QA: For the laboratory's own quality checks.

sample.needsQuantity: Record the unit's weight or seed count first.
sample.next: The sample is created in the same location. Print its label from its own page, and record its lab results there.

waste.title: Record waste
waste.description: Part of {name} was disposed of as waste. {name} keeps what is left.
waste.methodHint: For example: rendered unusable with cat litter, then composted.
waste.dateHint: Leave empty for now. A past date is allowed for a late entry.
waste.ctls: Waste is reported as destroyed on the monthly CTLS return.

split.title: Split the group
split.description: Move some of the {count} plants of {name} into a new group. {name} keeps the rest.

merge.title: Merge into another group
merge.description: All {count} plants of {name} join another group, which counts them from now on. {name} is kept on record, inactive.
merge.intoHint: Groups of the same experiment, cultivar and growth stage.
merge.none: No other group of the same experiment, cultivar and stage can take these plants.
merge.next: This cannot be undone: the group becomes read-only.
merge.success: {name} now has {count, plural, one {# plant} other {# plants}}

tissue.title: Take a tissue sample
tissue.description: A small piece of {name} for a lab test. It does not change what the unit counts for.
tissue.noteHint: Optional: which leaf or vessel, the lab it goes to.
tissue.next: The sample gets a code: print its label from the Quality tab, then record the result on it.

actions.notActive: This unit is inactive: no more actions can be taken on it.

overview.seedLotCount: Seed lot, {count, plural, one {# seed} other {# seeds}}

timing.title: Stage timing
timing.description: Days spent in each phase of the lifecycle.
timing.empty: No stage changes recorded yet. Record a stage change to start the clock.
timing.total: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} in total

locations.title: Location history
locations.description: Every room this unit has been in, from its recorded moves.
locations.inRoom: In {location} for {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
locations.empty: No location has been recorded for this unit.

label.qrTitle: QR code that opens the record of {name}

lineage.originDescription: The chain of cuttings back to the original mother.
lineage.generation: {count, plural, =0 {This unit is the mother} one {# propagation step from the mother} other {# propagation steps from the mother}}
lineage.noParent: {name} starts its own line: no parent unit has been recorded.
lineage.derivedDescription: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing derived from this unit yet} one {# unit derived from this one} other {# units derived from this one}}
lineage.noChildren: No clones, cuttings or subcultures have been taken from this unit.
lineage.moreChildren: Showing {shown, number} of {total, number} derived units.
lineage.deriveNext: Deriving never changes this unit, so it can be cut as many times as needed.
lineage.experimentsDescription: The experiment this unit belongs to and the ones around it.
lineage.noExperiment: This unit is not part of an experiment.

tests.title: Lab results
tests.caption: Lab results for this unit
tests.empty: No lab results have been recorded for this unit.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.description: Quality incidents opened against this unit.
incidents.caption: Incidents for this unit
incidents.empty: No incidents have been reported for this unit.

holds.title: Hold history
holds.description: Every quality hold this unit has had, with who placed and who released it.
holds.caption: Quality holds for this unit
holds.empty: This unit has never been on hold.

documents.title: Documents
documents.caption: Documents attached to this unit
documents.empty: No documents have been attached to this unit.

activities.title: Activity
activities.description: Treatments, feeding, observations and other work recorded on this unit.
activities.caption: Activities for this unit
activities.empty: No activities have been recorded for this unit.

samples.title: Samples
samples.description: Parts of this unit taken as samples. Each is a unit of its own, with its own label and lab results.
samples.caption: Samples taken from this unit

tissue.title: Tissue samples
tissue.description: Small pieces taken for lab tests. They are used up by the test and are not inventory.
tissue.caption: Tissue samples

ledger.title: Unit history
ledger.description: {count, plural, one {# recorded event} other {# recorded events}}, newest first.
ledger.caption: History of this unit
ledger.immutable: Events cannot be edited or deleted. A correction is recorded as a new event, so the history always shows what was known and when.
ledger.emptyBody: Events appear here as soon as they are recorded.
ledger.truncated: Showing the newest {shown, number} of {total, number} events. The audit report lists all of them.

text.RECEIVED_UNKNOWN: Received from an organization that was not recorded
text.REGROUPED: {count, plural, one {# plant} other {# plants}} in the group
text.SHIPPED_UNKNOWN: Shipped to an organization that was not recorded
text.MOVED: Moved from {from} to {to}{scan, select, yes { (barcode confirmed)} other { (not scanned)}}
text.SHIPPED_QTY_UNKNOWN: Shipped {quantity} to an organization that was not recorded

export.immutable: Every row below was recorded by the person named and cannot be edited. Times include the laboratory time zone.

lifecycle.active: {count, plural, one {# active unit} other {# active units}}

bulk.selectAll: Select all units on this page
bulk.selected: {count, plural, one {# unit selected} other {# units selected}}
bulk.applies: {eligible, plural, one {# of {total} selected units will be updated.} other {# of {total} selected units will be updated.}}
bulk.none: None of the selected units can take this action.
bulk.allOrNothing: All or nothing: if one unit is refused, none is changed.

move.title: Move {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}
move.description: Each unit gets its own move in its history. No barcode scan is needed for a bulk move.
move.success: {count, plural, one {# unit moved} other {# units moved}}

stage.title: Change the stage of {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}
stage.description: Each unit gets its own stage change in its history.
stage.effectiveDateHint: Leave empty for now. A past date is allowed for a late entry.
stage.success: {count, plural, one {# unit changed stage} other {# units changed stage}}

activity.title: Record an activity on {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}
activity.description: Each unit gets its own entry in its history, with the same details. Held units are included.
activity.activityTitleHint: For example: Foliar spray against powdery mildew.
activity.productHint: Required for a pesticide or a release of beneficial insects.
activity.pcpNumberHint: The Pest Control Products Act number on the label. Only registered products may be used.
activity.amountHint: In total, across the selected units.
activity.amountUnitHint: For example mL, L, g or insects.
activity.methodHint: For example foliar spray, drench or release.
activity.dateHint: Leave empty for now. A past date is allowed for a late entry.
activity.success: {count, plural, one {Activity recorded on # unit} other {Activity recorded on # units}}

hold.title: Place {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} on hold
hold.description: One reason, recorded on each unit.
hold.reasonHint: Say what was observed. At least 3 characters.
hold.next: While on hold, a unit cannot be moved, change stage, be derived from, be shipped or be destroyed. Only an administrator can release it.
hold.success: {count, plural, one {# unit placed on hold} other {# units placed on hold}}

destroy.title: Record the destruction of {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}
destroy.description: Destruction removes the units from inventory and is recorded permanently, on each unit.
destroy.irreversible: This cannot be undone. The units become read-only and each record names you.
destroy.success: {count, plural, one {Destruction of # unit recorded} other {Destruction of # units recorded}}

bulk.noneCan: None of the selected units can take this action.

release.title: Release the hold on {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}
release.description: One reason, recorded on each unit. Your password is confirmed before the holds are released.
release.reasonHint: Say what was checked and found. At least {count} characters.
release.success: {count, plural, one {Hold released on # unit} other {Holds released on # units}}
